178919.overview: Taisen Hot Gimmick: Axes-Jong is a Mahjong game, developed by Psikyo and published by X-Nauts, which was released in Japan in 2005.

178925.overview: Taisen Hot Gimmick: Cosplay-jong is a Mahjong game, developed by Psikyo and published by X-Nauts, which was released in Japan in 2004.

178928.overview: Taishou Mononoke Ibunroku is a Strategy game, published by Gust, which was released in Japan in 2003

178932.overview: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Innocent Black is an Adventure game, developed and published by WorkJam, which was released in Japan in 2002.

178936.overview:
Tenshi no Present: Marl Ōkoku Monogatari (Angel's Present: Marl Kingdom Stories) is the third main title in Nippon Ichi's Marl Kingdom series of fairy tale RPGs. Unlike the previous titles, Tenshi no Present is broken up into five unconnected chapters, which each focus on a separate story starring different characters. These stories take place throughout the series timeline; before, during, and after the first and second games. A sixth bonus chapter is unlocked after the first five are completed.

The battle system is based on that of the previous game, taking a straightforward turn-based approach. The player can control up to four "leader" characters, which can themselves each have up to three "partner" characters; leaders can be directly controlled, while most partners cannot. Different partners may attack automatically, or give boosts or other assists to the main party.

178941.overview:
In Sandlot's videogame adaption, released July 1, 2004, you control Tetsujin 28 from the point of view of Shotaro Kaneda—able to control both Shotaru and Tetsujin 28. The control method is slightly simplified compared to Sandlot's other giant robot games such as Robot Alchemic Drive, in that you are not asked to control each leg separately. But you gain the ability to fly Tetsujin 28, and well as have him pick up buildings, enemies, and even Shotaru.

The game uses the same voice actors as the animation, though it takes presentation cues from the anime, the manga, as well as the kaiju film genre.

178942.overview:
It is the Bakumatsu era in Japan - 1860-ies, the time when the feudal rulers of Japan, the dynasty of Tokugawa shoguns, were continuously suffering under the attacks of rebelling groups that wished to end the Tokugawa reign and to restore the Empire. Young people all over Japan united into clans and organizations, wishing to conquer the power in the capital city Edo. At that time - - according to this game - divine and demonic creatures also started gaining power. You, the protagonist of the game (who also happens to be the ancestor of Tatsuma Hiyuu, the main hero of earlier Tokyo Majin games), can join either the forces of Light or the forces of Shadow (deriving from the Chinese concepts Yang and Yin, respectively). Once you complete the game as one of the sides, you can unlock a third group you can replay the game with. Beside participating in conflicts among various political and demonic organizations within Japan, you also come into contact with the gods from Nordic mythology - Odin, Freia, Loki, and others, who are also interested in what is happening in the Far East.

According to the tradition of Tokyo Majin games, this is an adventure/strategy RPG hybrid. In the adventure mode, you talk to characters and give you answers to them by selecting one of the nine "emotions": love, friendship, joy, agreement, sorrow, anger, indecision, scorn, and ignorance. The answers determine your relationships with the characters in the game and also alter the story progression. In battle mode, your party fights on isometric battle screens, moving around the battlefield and attacking when enemy is in rage.

178943.overview: The Japanese version of Tomak: Save the Earth adds new contents and features. New routes expand the original game's story with additional love interests beyond just Evian, with new endings if players end up falling in love with a different character. The Korean releases also include selectable audio tracks, letting players choose between the original Korean voice acting and the Japanese dub.

178945.overview:
Train Simulator is a Japanese train simulation game series produced by Ongakukan. The game is significant as it was one of the earliest of its kind since the series started in 1995. No versions were licensed outside of Asia, therefore all of Train Simulator games are only available in Japanese, except Railfan: Taiwan High Speed Rail which is also translated in Traditional Chinese and English.

This PlayStation 2 version from August 2005 covers the Keisei, Toei Asakusa and Keikyu Lines.

178946.overview:
Train Simulator is a Japanese train simulation game series produced by Ongakukan. The game is significant as it was one of the earliest of its kind since the series started in 1995. No versions were licensed outside of Asia, therefore all of Train Simulator games are only available in Japanese, except Railfan: Taiwan High Speed Rail which is also translated in Traditional Chinese and English.

Each game contains Japanese lines and trains, with the exception of four episodes located overseas, in Germany, France, United States of America and Taiwan. Video shot from the cab of the train synchronized with the computer is used as a basis for simulation. Ongakukan have endeavoured to produce true to life simulation with much technical details, and since 2005, Ongakukan has started producing professional simulators for driver training.

This PlayStation 2 version from 2005 covers the Kyuushuu Shinkansen line.

178947.overview:
Train Simulator is a Japanese train simulation game series produced by Ongakukan.

Each game contains Japanese lines and trains, with the exception of four episodes located overseas, in Germany, France, United States of America and Taiwan. Video shot from the cab of the train synchronized with the computer is used as a basis for simulation.

This PlayStation 2 version from 2003 covers the Osaka Metro Midousuji Line.

178962.overview:
Train Simulator is a Japanese train simulation game series produced by Ongakukan. The game is significant as it was one of the earliest of its kind since the series started in 1995. No versions were licensed outside of Asia, therefore all of Train Simulator games are only available in Japanese, except Railfan: Taiwan High Speed Rail which is also translated in Traditional Chinese and English.

Each game contains Japanese lines and trains, with the exception of four episodes located overseas, in Germany, France, United States of America and Taiwan. Video shot from the cab of the train synchronized with the computer is used as a basis for simulation. 

This PlayStation 2 version covers one of Tokyo's busiest and most important line, the Yamanote Line.

180319.overview: The game's story, titled The Transformers: Call of the Future, takes its cue from the original cartoon, even specifically referring to the events of several episodes. It is (presumably) set in 2003, the year it was released, but, via time travel, also features characters from an alternate future which branched off from cartoon continuity in late 2010 (after the events of "Webworld", but before "The Return of Optimus Prime, Part 1"). It does not seem to be officially considered part of the Japanese Generation 1 cartoon continuity, however; it features several anachronistic appearances by characters who are not time-travelling (the Headmasters, for instance, are shown to be working with their respective factions, when they will not leave their homeworld to do so until 2011), and its events were not included in the painfully comprehensive 2007 timeline.

180903.overview: Tetris Kiwamemichi is a Tetris game for the Playstation 2 which was ported from the Sega Naomi arcade platform.  The game features several different modes, the most unique being Co-Op Play.  In this mode, up to 4 players clear lines within a shared playfield. Unlike most Tetris games with this mode, each player can freely move their piece across the entire width of the playfield.  A Battle Mode is also available.

180940.overview:
A compilation of seven of Tecmo's arcade games from the company's past. Bonus material include; dip switch settings, debug modes, reproduction of printed materials and instructions

The games included are:

Star Force
Solomon's Key
Bomb Jack
Tecmo Cup
Pinball Action
Pleiads

180941.overview: Tenka-bito is a strategy game for the PlayStation 2 developed by Shade and published by Sega. It was only released in Japan

180942.overview: A love adventure game that has you, Atsuya Funagai -- a 25-year-old member of a futuristic outfit being attacked by giant squid creatures -- training a squad of five females to become pilots of Skelter mech units. Battle the enemy with the game's Interactive Command Assist battle engine (a semi-action-based battle system) and engage in conversation with the your team members. The game features interactive conversation sequences in which you attempt to improve your favor with the girls as well as training scenes where you help the girls out in battle. In the "ICA" (Interactive Command Assist) battle system, you move a cursor around the screen to take out targets, helping the girls grow. The game's ending changes depending on which girl gets most of your attention.

180944.overview: Toro to Kyuujitsu is an Adventure game, published by SCEI, which was released in Japan in 2001.

182992.overview: Taiko no Tatsujin: Tatacon de Dodon ga Don is the very first home console release in Namco’s long-running rhythm franchise. Released for the PlayStation 2 on 24 October 2002, it introduced the iconic TaTaCon drum peripheral to living rooms across Japan. Because it was based on the Taiko no Tatsujin 3 arcade hardware, it famously brought arcade-accurate gameplay—along with the introduction of the brutal Oni (Demon) difficulty—straight to home players.

182997.overview: Waku Waku Anime Matsuri is one of the many titles in Namco's Taiko no Tatsujin taiko drum rhythm game; this particular entry is devoted entirely to anime theme songs, including themes from famous shows like Doraemon, One Piece, Inuyasha, and Sailor Moon. As usual, players must tap along with the rhythm of various songs in taiko drum style. There are a total of 19 tracks, and the usual Arcade, Free, and Survival modes return.

182999.overview: Taiko no Tatsujin: Go! Go! Godaime! (太鼓の達人 ゴー！ゴー！五代目) is a classic rhythm game developed and published by Namco for the PlayStation 2, originally released in Japan on December 9, 2004. As the fifth entry in the home console series, it holds a notable place in Taiko history for introducing several major gameplay mechanics that became permanent staples of the franchise.

183000.overview:
aiko no Tatsujin: Tobikkiri! Anime Special (Japanese: 太鼓の達人 とびっきり！アニメスペシャル, Taiko no Tatsujin: Tobikkiri! Anime Supesharu) is a Taiko no Tatsujin game for Playstation 2 on August 4, 2005. It is the second anime song compilation after Taiko no Tatsujin: Waku Waku Anime Matsuri.

Unique to this compilation is that most Namco Original songs debut in this game are sang by anime song artists: Ichiro Mizuki, Mitsuko Horie and Hironobu Kageyama, who are commonly known for performs anime songs. 

For Tobikkiri! Anime Special, there are 3 main minigames. The minigames are as follows: 
     Floating Parasol (Japanese: ふわふらパラソル, Fuwafura Parasoru) - In this minigame, player is in control of Don or Katsu and help them reach the goal while floating in the air via a umbrella and avoids obstacles. In the special course, player is instead controling Turtle, who is using a pair of folding fans instead of umbrella to floats. If donder managed to complete the minigame, the game reveal that the whole minigame is a dream of either Don or Katsu, who rolling off of the Wada household's roof as he wakes up by Tetsuo's warning.
    Squirt Gun in Bathroom (Japanese: お風呂で水鉄砲, Ofuro de Suitetsuhou) - In this minigame, player is in control of either Tetsuo or Hana, armed with squirt guns. Player must hit the objects (Either the chicks or the Mizu-Marikos) in the air to gains points. In the special course, the large amount of bubbles covering the bath, increasing the difficulty.
    Fly, Ladle! (Japanese: 杓子、とんでけー！, Shakushi, Tondeke!) - In this minigame, player is control of the Cat of the Cat and Ladle duo, and player can throws Ladle into the air as far as possible. In the special course, player must throw Ladle to the specific distance.

183001.overview: Wai Wai Happy! Rokudaime is one of the many titles in Namco's Taiko no Tatsujin taiko drum rhythm game. As usual, players must tap along with the rhythm of various songs in taiko drum style, with a total of 48 songs featured in this release. Free mode is the main mode, where one or two players can play and earn points towards unlockables, and there is also a Battle mode for up to eight players and the usual mini-games.

185615.overview: TVDJ is an Action/Music game, developed and published by SCEI, which was released in Japan in 2000

185616.overview:
Hugo Ramanski, son of a famous researcher, has come to a planet 3000 light years from Earth called Conius Blue. However, after a spaceship crash, he winds up stranded on the opposite side of the planet from the research station. With nothing but a powered glider and his own wits, Hugo must find a way to survive until he can find a way back to the station. Of course, he'll have a little help from the planet's natives -- innumerable species of migratory birds -- if he can earn their trust.

Aerial Planet is a sci-fi flight and survival simulation game set on a distant planet. The game is divided into two sections: flight mode and camp mode. In flight mode, the player controls Hugo as he pilots his glider. It is possible to interact with the different types of birds, following their flight paths and recording their calls, which can be played back to communicate with them. Through communicating with the birds and exploring ever further from the camp, the player can learn more about the planet, find additional camp sites, and ultimately figure out how to reach the research base. While in flight, it is also possible to take photographs which can be reviewed later.

In camp mode, the player can review currently-active objectives, as well as check the known information for each bird type that has been encountered. It is also only possible to eat and rest while at the camp, which Hugo must do in order to survive. His stamina will steadily deplete while in flight, and flying in certain conditions such as rain and snow will cause his stamina to deplete more quickly.

200176.overview:
The 9th installment of the Tantei Jinguuji Saburo (Jake Hunter) series. Jingūji is bored and tired after several months without any cases. He gladly returns to work when the Kantō mafia requests the investigation of a certain individual.

https://archive.org/details/tantei-jinguuji-saburo-kind-of-blue-official-perfect-guide

201064.overview: Tennis game produced by Konami's Satoshi Shimomura. Based on the popular Shonen Jump comic Tennis no Ouji-Sama, the tennis simulation game stars 53 different characters, a training mode that allows you to build up your players' stats, as well as plenty other sim-type parameters that influence performance and ultimately lead to victory. Also included this time: a gallery mode that allows playback of special event screens. All in all more than 250 of these are included, featuring hand-drawn art in the style of the manga. The Japanese franchise title, Tennis no Ouji-Sama, translates to "The Prince of Tennis."

201067.overview: Like the name hints, it is an updated version of Smash Hit. It features more than 40 characters from the manga, each playable character will have his own unique special moves. In addition to tennis, there are a couple of bonus games included, such as bowling.

204463.overview: Limited and modified version of Toca Race Driver 3, sold in car showrooms and trade shows.

205443.overview: The Tairyou Jigoku is an Action Adventure game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

207237.overview:
Futakoi Alternative tells the story of Rentarō Futaba and his detective agency. One day a set of twins, Sara and Sōju, show up at his doorstep. They move in with him and work as secretaries for his agency.

Futakoi Alternative is a visual novel based upon the Japanese anime television series created by character designer Mutsumi Sasaki and planner & scenario writer Hina Futaba. The show features many of the characters from the original Futakoi, though the story and settings are completely different.

207558.overview: Based on the popular "Tough" comic, featured in Young Jump magazine. Tough: Dark Fight features an original story that takes place in the two years between the original "Koukou Tekken-den Tough" comic (published between 1993 and 2003) and the later "Tough" reprisal series. Fans of the series will be able to experience the happenings of those two missing years. The game features a number of characters, including eight who haven't been featured in the comic.

210920.overview: Toudai Shogi: Shikenbisha Dojo is a Miscellaneous game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2000.

210993.overview:
Truck Kyousokyoku is a Racing game, published by Metro, which was released in Japan in 2000. 
The Dekotora or Decotora, an abbreviation for "decoration truck", is a type of extravagantly decorated truck in Japan. Commonly displaying neon or ultraviolet lights, extravagant paints and stainless or golden exterior parts, on both on the exterior and the interior. Dekotora may be created by workers out of their work trucks for fun, or they may be designed by hobbyists for special events. They are sometimes also referred to as Art Trucks.

Truck Kyousoukyoku - Ai to Kanashimi no Rodeo: Taking inspiration from the hugely popular decotora truck games from the Playstation, Namco developed a System 23 coin-op called Truck Mania Concerto. The PS2 port of this game betters the original with new tracks and additional graphical details. As the truck maneuvering maniac, your goal is to race against competing truckers any which way but loose. Drive on sidewalks, search for shortcuts, discover secret roads and plunge headlong into traffic with no reservation. You are, after all, a maniac.

Upon winning races, the player gets a can of aerosol to paint designs and emblems on the body of the truck. The sides, top, back, and head of the vehicle are open canvases for you to drop paint and swirl a menacing symbol or a nature panorama. Preset designs may be chosen or you can create your own doodles which help you help your truck emote. The action is hot and the paint jobs add to the ambience.

210997.overview: Technictix is an Action game, developed and published by Arika, which was released in Japan in 2001.

211595.overview: Tengai Makyou III: Namida is an Adventure game, developed and published by Hudson, which was released in Japan in 2005.

211596.overview: Sports game based on the tennis-themed manga of the same name. Released in July 2003 in two variations, a standard and a limited edition containing special collectible trading cards. Since it's made for the Prince of Tennis franchise it is a tennis game. Smash Hit includes most of the players' specials moves up until the end of the Kantou tournament, so any moves introduced after are not included in the game.

211597.overview:
Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side is a female-oriented dating sim video game released by Konami for the PlayStation 2 game console on June 20, 2002. It was also rereleased with enhancements for the Nintendo DS as Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side: 1st Love on February 15, 2007. It has two sequels: Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side: 2nd Kiss and Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side: 3rd Story. The original game also received a version for mobile phones in 2010.

Tokimeki Memorial: Girl's Side is just what its title implies: a dating simulation game similar in style to the main Tokimeki Memorial series, but with a very important difference: the main character is female, and the romantic interests are of the opposite sex.

The game's main character is a student at the fictional private school, Habataki High School, located in the fictional city of Habataki. The protagonist has returned to Habataki after living away for a time due to her parents' work, but she lived there as a child. While leading a normal high school life including academics, club activities and part-time work, it is also possible to become friendly with boys who can make a declaration of love on graduation day.

Although the Tokimeki Memorial series was originally male-oriented, this game is directed toward the female market and involves a female protagonist looking for love amongst a cast of male characters. Some modifications in game-play were also made to make the game more appealing to female gamers. The player is able to go shopping on her free days to buy clothes and is able to change her daily attire as well as dressing-up for a date. In addition to the male love-interest characters, there are also female characters who can become the player's friends, study together, go out for coffee, etc. These characters can also become love rivals. The parameters which are built up through different activities include academic ability, art, popularity, sport, attentiveness and beauty.

211598.overview: Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side: 2nd Kiss is an adventure game, developed and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2006.

211599.overview:
In Tokyo Bus Annai, players drive on three real-world routes of the Toei Bus service. In addition to stopping at the right bus stops on time, triggering announcements, and ensuring passenger comfort by not accelerating or braking too harshly, drivers also have to follow the rules of traffic by stopping at traffic lights, obeying speed limits, and correctly indicating when turning or changing lanes. Part of a green "life bar" in the lower left corner of the screen turns red every time a rule is violated or a task not completed correctly. More serious violations, such as crashing into another vehicle, entail more serious consequences than minor mishaps, such as forgetting to announce the next stop. The life bar can be replenished by passing or stopping at stations on time. When the life bar turns entirely red, the player is forced to retire prematurely.

The three routes selectable in the game are the Niji 01 (across the Rainbow Bridge in Tokyo Bay area), Tian 70 (in the busy Shinjuku ward; this line was decommissioned in 2000), and Ume 76 (a more rural route in Western Tokyo). All the routes can be driven at noon, in the evening, or at night, with respectively different traffic density and amount of passengers. Some of the routes and schedules have to be unlocked by gaining experience in Story mode. Story mode also includes short cutscenes of interactions and monologues of some of the passengers, which play at certain bus stops. These cutscenes unlock brief files on the respective passenger's profiles in the main menu, along with occasional entries into an album. There is also a Free Run mode where no data is saved and no content can be unlocked.

A mini-game that can be downloaded to the Visual Memory unit is a quiz game on Japanese road signs.

217668.overview:
Strap on you helmet and pads so you can skate around in Wasteland. Tony Hawk and the gang are back once again with more challenges for you to skate to.

Included in this edition:

-    Tony Hawk's American Wasteland
-    Two exclusive classic mode levels
-    Two exclusive secret characters
-    The “Making of Tony Hawk’s American Wasteland” documentary
-    A concept art gallery featuring creations by legendary artist Jimbo Philips

419211.overview: Tomoyo After: It's a Wonderful Life - CS Edition is an Adventure game, developed and published by Prototype, which was released in Japan in 2007.

420333.overview:
From chain mails that leads to murder, mysterious suicides and missing children, you, as a police officer have to put all your brain cells to work, connect the events together to discover the truth. Besides the three that you solve as a policeman, there is a bonus chapter where you need to find the culprit behind a series of foretold murders.

One case starts out with you receiving mysterious chain mails from an unknown sender’s mobile phone, who claims to have witnessed a serial killer. Another involves investigating suicides.

Kogure Souichirou is the main character from the Survival Horror game Hayarigami for the Playstation 2. Kogure is a police officer who has a fear of anything paranormal, which doesn't help when his next assignment is to deal with the paranormal occurrences happening around the city (such as Bloody Mary, Creepy Chain Mail and Alligators In the Sewer).

421662.overview: This expansion pack for A Ressha de Ikō 2001 adds 63 new trains officially licensed from Japanese rail providers. It also introduces a new screenshot feature, allowing players to save screenshots on the PS2's internal hard drive and transfer them to a computer.

435449.overview: The story begins with Nozomu Futami returning to the town where he was born and raised as a child. He moves in near a shrine which houses a legendary stone that was rumoured to have been the place where twin girls turned into birds. The stone is rumoured to be the cause of an abundance of twin girls who are born in the town. The twins who turned into birds did so because of their love for a man who couldn't choose between them. Shortly after Nozomu enters town he begins to run into the same problems as six pairs of twins fight for his love.

438271.overview: Raise the best women's marathon runners to become the world's best club team! The player is the owner and manager of the club team.

438274.overview:
"Toukon Spirit" Antonio Inoki produces a wrestling-style puzzle game!

Easy rules and hot competition! A puzzle game with easy rules and hot battles!
The controls and rules are simple, as everyone can easily get used to the falling object puzzle! The game also features powerful cut-in animations, flashy sound effects, and other exciting effects!

Full cooperation from the Inoki Office, which is great for pro-wrestling fans!
Antonio Inoki and other popular wrestlers of New Japan Pro Wrestling appear with their real names! Hidekazu Tanaka (Kero-chan), an active ring announcer, does the live announcements! The background music is the passionate "Inokibombaye"!

Full of treasured audio and video data for Inoki fans!
In the "Toukon Memorial Hall" mode, you can listen to Inoki's many "Inoki's words" in live voice, as well as watch videos of his famous fights! In addition, there are also secret videos that can only be seen in this game!

439026.overview:
Touka Gettan -Koufuu no Ryouou- (Deluxe Pack): This edition includes a mini-drama DVD "Gentou Momotsuki Soushi". It also bundles with "Kao no nai Tsuki Select Story", featuring a PS2-exclusive Suzuna after story.

Touka Gettan is set in the land of Kamitsumihara, where traces of magic and legend can still be seen. The land has been under the protection of the Kamiazuma clan since it was founded. The story revolves around Touka Kamiazuma, the main protagonist, who has lost all his memory, and his body has stopped growing. It sounds like he is in misery, but he somehow enjoys his life with his mother. One day, he joins a high school located nearby, believing it will bring back his memory..

439041.overview: Touka Gettan is set in the land of Kamitsumihara, where traces of magic and legend can still be seen. The land has been under the protection of the Kamiazuma clan since it was founded. The story revolves around Touka Kamiazuma, the main protagonist, who has lost all his memory, and his body has stopped growing. It sounds like he is in misery, but he somehow enjoys his life with his mother. One day, he joins a high school located nearby, believing it will bring back his memory..

439043.overview: Katei no Igaku TV Ware Series is a Miscellaneous game, published by Artdink, which was released in Japan in 2001.

439975.overview:
All "fighting spirits" will be gathered here! 
The world's first real-time high-speed online wrestling game!

With more than 1,500 techniques and 4,500 parts, you can create your own wrestler!
Over 50 different matchmaking styles and 4 different venues to hone your mind, body, and soul!
Connect online and unite with your comrades across the country!

440355.overview:
Thread Colors - Sayonara no Mukougawa: Childhood friends and new mates are met in high school and the town hospital when the main character of the game interacts with four teenage girls and a leggy guidance counselor. As the game begins, the player wakes up at a hospital with memory loss and struggles to remember a life lived and friendships from the past.

The game takes place primarily at the hospital and the local high school where the girls drift in and out of the player's daily life. During the hospital stay, our hero befriends a girl who tends to be sickly and naïve to the ways of the world but perhaps the two will help each other recover from their respective ailments.

Full voice action and a special theme song sung by Hiromi Sato provides a plethora of aural enjoyment.

441233.overview: Kyoushuu Kidou Butai: Kougeki Helicopter Senki is an Action game, developed by ASK and published by Taito Corporation, which was released in Japan in 2004. The North American release was to be titled Threat Con Delta but was canceled.

441449.overview:
The Keihin Kyuukou - Train Simulator Real: With Japanese citizens marching to the beat of a frenetic drum, time is of the essence when you're the man who takes salarymen, students and secretaries to their jobs and rounds every morning. Accelerate, decelerate and toot your horn whilst passing intersections to ward off potential passers. A follow up to The Yamate Line from earlier this year, Sony trains it's development skills on the competing Keihin bullet line in Japan. Big iron buffs may thrill to the use of live video footage in this game where complete routes have been transposed from video to PS2.

The game includes all train types including the latest Type 1000. The user can also choose their favorite cars and link them together for the game. The distinctive motor sound is also worthy of note. Lines included: Keihin Express Railway Main Line, Misakiguichi - Shinagawa and Kurihama Line, Haneda Airport - Keikyu Kamata.

442216.overview: From the creators of Magic Pengel: The Quest for Color comes Tensai Bit-kun Gramon Battle, another monster-raising "sim". Developed by Gakaruta Studios and published by Taito, Gramon Battle makes the player construct a monster of his (or her) very own. The game is based on a concept created by NHK Kyouiku, and the designers are taking a large part in making sure that the game stays faithful to the show. There will be over 2,000 possible variations for character creation.

442349.overview: Tennis no Oji-Sama - Card Hunter is a trading card game released on Playstation 2 for the Prince of Tennis Franchise. Prince of Tennis - Card Hunter is the first installment of digital card gaming of the Prince of Tennis anime and manga series. It is based on the real Prince of Tennis Trading Card Game created by Konami in Japan.

442350.overview:
Tennis no Oji-Sama - DokiDoki Survival - Umibe no Secret: Targeted at girl gamers, the second Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival game in as many months moves from the mountain setting in the first game to the seashore. At the outset, the heroine is aboard a ship with 40 Prince of Tennis characters. The first scene takes place in the dining room where some of the boys introduce themselves but everyone eventually retires to their rooms. Sometime in the night, a massive storm causes a little bit of panic but the crew eventually guides the ship onto land and the characters regain their footing.

Although the game features 40 tennis players, only 20 of the boys are fair game for love and romance. The scenario length for each character is lengthier than in the original DokiDoki game so there's more time to enjoy special moments and view magical screenshots. Or something to that effect. The aim of the game is procuring a love confession from one of the boys and then watching the happy ending.

442355.overview:
The protagonist is a junior high student named Kohinata Tsugumi, whose father is a ship captain who is currently carrying the tennis teams to the place they are supposed to have a training camp.

After a shipwreck, you are saved by Kaidoh and Momoshjiro and then by Tezuka. you loose consciousness afterwards, and awakens to Tezuka and Akaya’s worried face.

444334.overview: Typing Shinken Shoubu: Musashi no Ken is an obscure, educational typing action game released for the Sony PlayStation 2 exclusively in Japan. Developed by Racjin and published by SunSoft on January 17, 2002, the title serves as both an anime-licensed game and a typing tutorial. It functions similarly to Sega's famous The Typing of the Dead, tasking players with utilizing a PS2-compatible USB keyboard peripheral to progress through the story.

444335.overview: Typing Renai Hakusho - Boys Be... is based on a manga and anime in Japan, Boys Be focuses on the trials of a group of high school students as they discover love and friendship. Although the focus of the series is on the two childhood friends Kyoichi and Chiharu, the other males and females also get their fair share of screen time and introspection. In order to help game players with their typing skills, Sunsoft entices fans of the Boys Be franchise with a set of exercises featuring the characters from the game. Letters appear onscreen and it's up to you to slap the keys accurately and at a goodly pace.

445095.overview: Taisen(4) Soldier is a Board game, developed by Yuki and published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2004.

445115.overview:
Taiheiyou no Arashi: Senkan Yamato, Akatsuki ni Shutsugeki su! is a Japanese World War II grand strategy video game developed and published by SystemSoft. 

The game's title translates roughly to "Storm of the Pacific: Battleship Yamato, Sortie at Dawn!" As part of SystemSoft's long-running historical strategy franchise, it focuses heavily on military logistics, resource management, and tactical naval and aerial warfare across the Pacific Theater. Players manage historical fleets, oversee troop movements, and dictate the deployment of iconic vessels like the Japanese battleship Yamato.Because it was only released in Japan, the game features complex menu-driven interfaces entirely in Japanese text, making it a niche import title for hardcore strategy enthusiasts.

445122.overview:
Taiko-Risshiden V is the 5th entry in Taikō Risshiden series.

In addition to the existing 3 occupations (Samurai, Ninja and merchant) in Taikō Risshiden IV, the game introduces more occupations: sword master, pirate, doctor, tea master and blacksmith. It also improved the card collection system and the number of characters.

445158.overview: Detective School Q is the story of a group of young students from Class Q of Dan Detective School (DDS), a prestigious and renowned detective academy founded by Morihiko Dan, the most famous detective in Japan, and the adventures and mysteries they unfold and solve together. They eventually work against Pluto, a mysterious organization which creates almost fool-proof plans that only a handful of detectives can solve.

445159.overview: TBS All Star Kansha Matsuri 2003 - Aki Chou Gouka Quiz Ketteiban is the second Playstation 2 game that is a version of the popular japanese TV Show (aired in Japan since 1991) hosted by Shinsuke Shimada & Wakako Shimazaki. The game features, 20 different characters to choose from, up to 4 human players to play at the same time using the multitap function and a few mini games.

445160.overview: The Prince of The School Festival (学園祭の王子様 Gakuensai no Oujisama) is a dating game made for the Prince of Tennis franchise.

445166.overview: Tennis no Ouji-Sama: Kiss of Prince Flame or Ice - Billed as a music clip game, this interactive music and mini-game collection is based on the tennis-themed manga of the same name. Available in two varions: Kiss of Prince Ice (Blue) and Kiss of Prince Flame (Red).

445167.overview: Tennis no Ouji-Sama: Kiss of Prince Flame or Ice - Billed as a music clip game, this interactive music and mini-game collection is based on the tennis-themed manga of the same name. Available in two varions: Kiss of Prince Ice (Blue) and Kiss of Prince Flame (Red).

445169.overview:
With Valentine's Day right around the corner, Konami included a bar of sweet or bitter chocolate with preorders in Japan. Unfortunately, our suppliers kept the sweets for themselves (for lunch, perhaps) but we'll see about getting some Hershey bars for our customers later in the day... Maybe. The game itself is a mix of interaction and music rhythm game where sprightly j-pop plays in the background.

Two versions are available - Sweet and Bitter which differ in the boy characters that are featured in each game.

445170.overview: Tentama tells the story of an angel in training that to become a full angel he has to visit Hayasegawa Shiina and his schoolmates and helps him to be happy, and to that he has to find a girlfriend in this adventure dating interactive game.

445172.overview: Tir Na Nog: Yuukyuu no Jin is a RPG based on Celtic myths. It comes with what is described as a "scenario generation function" that changes the way you play each time. Tir Na Nog offers 8 different main stories each with multiple endings. The battle is done through an auto-battle feature that requires you organize, strategize, and properly equip characters. Characters have their own personalities and abilities. There are over 300 different events that can happen throughout the game and it depends largely on how you handle each one. It features a Pictoral Book where you can collect and view over 300 events. As a heroic spirit, the player goes on adventures with up to 5 parties, improves ability in battle, gains items, grows in affection with friends, and races with various parties become companions such as elves and dwarfs as well as over 120 tribes.

445173.overview: Surrounded by a beautiful valley, Mount Fuji is not only the most famous mountain of Japan, but also - according to old legends - the home of gods. It is said that once the country plunges into the age of disasters, the soul of the saviour will be reincarnated in one of the people living near the mountain. Presently, a devastating, menacing power appears on the horizon - the heavenly demons, the Tenma. You control Asuka Inami, a student at the Tenshou Highschool, which is situated in the valley near Mount Fuji. With the help of your fellow students - including those of the rival military academy Tsukuyomu, composed of members of anti-Tenma brigade - you'll have to discover your true destination and to save your land.

445853.overview: Tentama 2 wins is a visual novel game. The story takes a couple of years after the original game and the main protagonist is Akira Ichinose, a high-school freshman who is staying at your relatives' place until graduation. The life seemed without any particular problems until one day, out of the blue, twin sisters, Kae and Momi, apprentice angels, no less, crash landed on top of Akira in his room.

445854.overview: Tennis no Ouji-Sama: Sweat & Tears 2 is based on the tennis-themed Shonen Jump manga of the same name. Players witness high school life and experience romantic (and otherwise) adventures in tennis class. The developers hired a large voice cast to supply each character with unique intros and voice-over work. Produced for Konami by Satoshi Shimomura. Released only in Japan.

445859.overview:
With Valentine's Day right around the corner, Konami included a bar of sweet or bitter chocolate with preorders in Japan. Unfortunately, our suppliers kept the sweets for themselves (for lunch, perhaps) but we'll see about getting some Hershey bars for our customers later in the day... Maybe. The game itself is a mix of interaction and music rhythm game where sprightly j-pop plays in the background.

Two versions are available - Sweet and Bitter which differ in the boy characters that are featured in each game.

445864.overview: Tensho Gakuen is a mixture of Japanese adventure and strategy RPG - similarly to Sakura Taisen games. When talking to characters, you can choose one of eight available answer types, symbolizing a certain feeling - friendship, anger, indifference, etc. Those answers will determine your relationships with the characters and change the direction of the plot. In adventure mode you can also choose to travel to various locations. In battle mode, you control a party that can move freely on the battle field and attack enemies within reach. Each turn requires action points; when they are depleted, the character must end the turn.

445867.overview: In the game the player takes the role of a first year high school student (the player can change the character's name at the beginning) that lost his parents a few years ago. He is in possession of a pendant that has been passed down from generation to generation and he has been learning kendo since he was in elementary school. The game begins when he starts high school meeting his childhood friend Kasumi and he has to prevent the revival of the monster.

445869.overview:
Rush and Dream is a dating game made for the Prince of Tennis franchise.

Third installment in the anime-based game series. This time, the game concentrates on the exploits of junior characters and their rise up to becoming a tennis star.

445870.overview: The protagonist of the story is a high-school sophomore Akio Haruno, living in a small rural town surrounded by beautiful landscapes. His parents have passed away and he is currently living alone. As the summer vacation is approaching, he met a girl by the name of Towa Natsunomori who just transferred to the same class he was in. Smitten by her charm with the feeling like she knows her even though he met her for the first time, he decides to find out more about her. The two of them soon become close and the summer memories are about to begin.

445871.overview: After being devastated in the third World War (known as The Third Division), Japan was divided in two. Several years after the end of the war, a crime organization called Vischio has taken control of the destroyed city of Toshima (formerly Tokyo, Japan's capital city), where they are holding a battle game known as Igura.

445872.overview:
In this game, you play as Hiroyuki Fujita, a high-school student who seems to have more interest in romance than in his studies. In his school there are several pretty girls, and his goal is to be nice to one of them, to make the right decisions when talking to her, and ultimately to win her heart.

Bundled with ToHeart 2 (Gentei Deluxe Pack).

445913.overview: Tokimeki Memorial 2: Music Video Clips: Circus de Ai Imashou is a mini games game in which the player will control Nozaki Sumire in different circus mini games to unlock video clips of 5 of the characters of Tokimeki Memorial 2.

446042.overview: Taisen(1) Shogi is a Shogi game, developed by Yuki and published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2004.

446049.overview: Taisen(3) Mahjong is a Board game, developed by Yuki and published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2004.

446052.overview: Taisen(2) Igo is a Board game, developed by Yuki and published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2004.

446057.overview:
Taikyoku Mahjong Net de Ron is a mahjong game that features the use of the online mode to play with another human player as your partner. The game features different game modes:
- Story: In this mode the player takes the role of a young girl that advance throught the game plot winning mahjong matches. In this mode the computer suggest the best mahjong piece to use in each turn.
- Online: In this mode the player can play with other human players online.
- Free mode: In this mode the player can play a quick mahjong match with the peculiar thing that got a time limit to perform the action.
- Gallery Modes: In this mode the player can watch the images that he unlocks playing the story mode.

446058.overview: Taikou Risshiden IV is a historical strategy and role-playing game developed and published by Koei, released for the Sony PlayStation 2 in Japan on November 29, 2001. Set during Japan's Sengoku (Warring States) period, the game primarily follows the life and rise of Hideyoshi Toyotomi, though it offers an open-ended experience where players can choose their own paths to success.

446075.overview: Teikoku Sensenki: The great empire fell into chaos after the emperor's death. The nation fracturing into three separate states, each led by their own king vying for power. Born a poor farmer's son, a young man lived who would become known as a military genius that changed the course of history.

446076.overview: An angel from heaven has been sent by God to help troubled souls on Earth. As a cherub in training, you dole out good deeds by way of slapping a percussion "instrument" in time to a stream of angel wings which descend on screen. Your archenemy in this exercise of rhythm aptitude rests in the dark and pointy tailed persona of a bat-winged demon girl. Musical flavour from around the world, represented by instruments from particular countries, provide the lullabies and strident interludes to play the game to.

446077.overview:
Touma busily lives everyday with Kasumi and Nami. One day, they receive an offer. That is to exorcize a monster. And they go hunting at night as usual. But, the monster is too tough to beat, and Touma and Kasumi get injured. Nami tries to beat it up by herself to protect Touma and Kasumi, but she is defeated...

The gameplay like in all visual novels is choose between different answers to advance in the game, and that will leave to an end of the story or another one, but the game in some parts got also a sort of rpg mode, since the battles with the monsters is a turn battle in which the player choose between different kind of attacks, but with the difficult part of chosing a wrong movement will leave to a death ending.

446079.overview: TBS All Star Kanshasai vol.1 - Chou Gouka! Quiz Ketteiban is the Playstation 2 version of the popular japanese TV Show (aired in Japan since 1991) hosted by Shinsuke Shimada & Wakako Shimazaki. The game features, 20 different characters to choose from, up to 4 human players to play at the same time using the multitap function and a few mini games.

446097.overview: Torikago no Mukougawa is a visual novel game in which the player takes the role of Hirojuki Hatori that has been summoned as the liberator of a dream world where he has to free their minds and open their hearts meanwhile he tries to return to his own world. Each location of the dream world in the game is show in different puzzle pieces, going to a location will take to a conversation to a character if is there, as usual in visual novels different answers will leave to different endings and situations. The game features unlockables galleries.

446098.overview: Yomoyama town, it is an old spa town and has been developed recently. There is a traditional festival called "Yomoyama Dai Taisai" taken place once every sixty years. However, this festival has another aspect.... called "Kuro Harai", it is said that the God comes to smash monsters called "Kuro". The main character has just moved to this town and he is chosen to play a role of God's partner at the festival. He doesn't know what is happening but is forced to take part in the festival....

446099.overview: A young J-pop music prodigy named Akari Tateshina loses her mentor. With Akari's guiding light gone from the picture, an uncertain destiny awaits her. The Japanese music industry churns out and recycles talent at a cruel pace but that won't do. Help Akari practice, train and hone her singing voice in order to keep her career on the proper trajectory until her debut as a J-pop star. Make that a lasting J-Pop starlet. Choice of music also helps or hinders her possible success in the industry.

446100.overview: Trouble Fortune Company Happy Cure: Trouble Fortune takes place in a high school, where you assume the role of a female student named Tsuzuri Kunisaki. The story is about our heroine Tsuzuri whose mother is a fortune teller. One day her mom Sakura goes missing in action, leaving Tsuzuri and her brother Amane, saying she’s gone to look for their father. She leaves without saying where she’s going and how long she’ll be gone and now all of her fortune telling customers demand to see her. It’s up to Tsuzuri to train so that she can become a super fortune teller and snag that man.

446101.overview: It's another year in high school and another chance for your onscreen romeo to find love amongst the crop of viable classmates. Work your schedule around a girl's classes and life in order to meet her in opportune occasions. Strike up a friendly chat or read her mind by checking out her facial expressions and replies. Reactions of the girls to your banter may be gauged by watching the ever present heart meter which swells if a girl becomes attracted to you or diminishes if you're a turn off. Success depends on reinforcement. Reinforce the notion that you're a good guy and beat the idea around that you'd be a good match for potential victims of your love.

446103.overview: Toudai Shogi: Jouseki Dojo Kanketsuhen is a board game, published by Mainichi Communications, which was released in Japan in 2004.

446105.overview: It's summertime once again and love is in the air. Encounter six new girls fresh out of high school - hit them up for light conversation and level up your love power with savvy and charm. The bulk of the gameplay consists of the conversation system where a series of inquiries are fired off at the girls and their level of interest depends on your line of questioning and attendant affability.

446107.overview: Tsuyokiss is about the lives of a group of fictional high school students and the often comedic events that occur in their lives. The main protagonist is an average boy named Leo Tsushima who is secretly in love with the eldest daughter of the Kiriya Corporation and who is the student council president - Erika Kiriya.

446110.overview: Towa no Sakura is an adventure game is based on a love triangle, and past lifes in which the story takes places in 3 different eras, the Taisho and Edo & the Muromachi, and the heroine will have to face dangers in company of some heroes that she will meet during her adventure.

446112.overview: What are my dreams? What are my hopes? What do I aspire to become? These are questions that the characters of this story ask themselves. But must all of them turn at last to weeping? Must they all harbor such darkness under the shadow of the wings of their hearts? Some of them carry the wounds of the past with them still, the burden causing them to lose sight of their dreams. Others see insurmountable walls between them and the things they dream of, causing them to walk away and give up. And still others -- worst of all -- have forgotten what it is to dream altogether.

446123.overview: Triangle Again 2 continues the story chapters where the prequel Triangle Again left off. The main scenario follows the story of Akari Tateshina, a young and talented pop singer, and her comeback to the scene. The game features many in-game choices with affect the story leading up to 15 different endings. The game offers up to 10 different save game slots which may help you try out different choices if you save at key points in order to clear many different story arcs. Replay option let you re-play the story arc to the game ending you have reached, making the game re-play feel like watching a full length anime movie.

446124.overview: I had a dream. The dream I had many times before. A sad parting dream.... "I'll give you these cards." "Oh, beautiful cards. Thank you." She was my best friend.... I was very sad..., but I still remember her last word. "Well, when you get older, these cards will be useful. Don't lose them!" "Ok, I'll surely keep them!" An alarm clock rings and I wake up. "Oh, where did I put those cards? Well, maybe here...." They are called the True Fortune Cards and each card has a face of a boy. He still doesn't know that the boys he will meet in the near future have the same faces written on the cards....

446130.overview: The new school term started today. The protagonist's childhood friend, Honami, has kept telling him that he's not a child anymore, and yet continues to come to wake him up. They proceed as they always have to 『Hasumidai Academy』, which stands atop a hill ... but this time around, as second-year students.

446186.overview: Tsuyokiss is about the lives of a group of fictional high school students and the often comedic events that occur in their lives. The main protagonist is an average boy named Leo Tsushima who is secretly in love with the eldest daughter of the Kiriya Corporation and who is the student council president - Erika Kiriya.

447064.overview: You play as a detective called Kyouichirou Sagara and must work to solve a number of cases. The game makes use of the "Parallel Character System" which allows you to view crimes from the perspective of multiple characters. Once you've cleared the first scenario, you gain the ability to select between scenarios two, three and four. Based on how you progress through the story, the ending will change.

448133.overview: Tokyo Bus Guide 2 is a Japan-only Bus Driving simulator released for the PlayStation 2 in 2005. In this game, you drive a bus on a route through Tokyo, picking up and letting off passengers at the bus stops. The Tokyo Bus Guide series is similar to Crazy Taxi, as they both involve carrying passengers through the city, but unlike Crazy Taxi, Tokyo Bus Guide strictly requires you to follow all of the rules of the road, right down to using your turn signal when changing lanes.

448358.overview: Nihongo Daijiten is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Kodansha and published by Artdink, which was released in Japan in 2001. Also known as The Great Japanese Dictionary.

451103.overview: Tetsu One: Densha de Battle! is a train simulation game, developed by Vingt-et-un Systems and published by Syscom, which was released in Japan in 2001.

460877.overview: The original Transformers have returned to star in this 3D beat-'em-up title. The player fights on a team alongside two allies controlled by the game. Vehicle and robot modes have been included in this game. Once they have been unlocked, you can play as several classic Autobots and Decepticons, such as Optimus Prime, Megatron, Hot Rod, and Starscream. Each Transformer can be upgraded by collecting Energon cubes and other items hidden in each level. The storyline has both factions arriving on the planet Zell in search of their missing allies, who were in pursuit of a mysterious UFO. All the voices are in English, but you can choose between Japanese or English subtitles.

465029.overview: TVware Jouhou Kakumei Series: Gendai Yougo no Kiso Chishiki 2001 is a niche digital reference title released exclusively in Japan for the Sony PlayStation 2.Rather than a traditional video game, it functions as an interactive, television-optimized encyclopedia based on the famous annual Japanese dictionary of current terminology, Gendai Yougo no Kiso Chishiki (Encyclopedia of Contemporary Words).

465227.overview:

Developed and published by Artdink, it launched in Japan on December 27, 2001, alongside three other regional versions (Shutoken/Tokyo Metropolitan, Toukai, and Zenkokuban/Nationwide). Rather than a game, it serves as an educational and utility tool converting the popular PC map software "Pro Atlas" for television use.

470514.overview: TVware Jouhou Kakumei Series: Pro Atlas for TV: Zenkokuban is a Japan-exclusive, non-traditional software release developed and published by Artdink for the Sony PlayStation 2. Released on December 27, 2001, it functions as an interactive digital map software and educational tool for home televisions rather than a standard video game.
